study.question: Does the validation penalty from canonicalizing whole full history blocks arise from the explicit coarse linear/quadratic summaries, and do those summaries improve click AUC over capacity-matched local-summary duplicates?
study.hypothesis: The existing whole-block canonicalization penalty is chiefly mediated by the third coarse linear and fourth coarse quadratic detail channels, rather than loss of original block membership. Replacing those two coefficient vectors with existing within-block-position coefficients should remove the supplied-versus-canonical full-block layout gap. A supplied-order ordinal advantage over supplied-order duplicates would support useful coarse ordinal information for this fixed architecture and training recipe, provisionally; no difference or improved duplicates would oppose that utility hypothesis. This is a local attribution hypothesis, not a new architecture or novelty claim.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary text lines56-120 describes target-dependent local activation and weighted pooling. We inherit the field/four-task adaptation and strongest joint model; test two explicit block-rank summaries with duplicate replacements, rather than reproduce DIN or claim a new pooling invention.

Pinned benchmark forward lines175-200 flattens the event representation into a joint tokenizer. We do not adopt flattening/tokenizers/UniMixing layers; keep the existing joint model and isolate its coarse summary coefficients. Original paper metadata paper:unimixer supplies provenance only; full paper unavailable.

Pinned benchmark forward lines132-172 retains sequence tokens and nonsequential tokens for repeated interaction. We keep existing compression and readout and test fixed ordinal channels. Original full paper paper:onetrans not supplied; no original-method reproduction or priority claim.

Closest local control reorders complete full blocks and all their fields/masks, leaves partial blocks and original groups fixed, and reports click AUC0.6660661993 versus identity0.6685268680. We reuse its exact layout implementation and cross block layout with two norm-matched local duplicate coefficient replacements.

inherited_components: All learned code, initialization, source gradient gates, optimizer ownership, Dice state, compression and nonlinear block/context transfer of g0-r0052-block_nonlinear_transfer.
Complete-tuple/full-block canonical layout from g1-r0055-blocks_canonical; within-block order frozen to supplied.
Original first target-match, second within-block position and fifth gated duplicate-match channels, including their support construction.
study.proposed_difference: Add architecture-only coarse_summary switch. Ordinal returns the original third block_coefficients and fourth quadratic coefficients. local_duplicate selects duplicated_position=centered_position*I(block_norm2>1e-12) for channel3 and centered_position*original_quadratic_support for channel4, before the unchanged summary bmm. These have the same coefficient norm as the corresponding original vectors on active nondegenerate support, introduce no learned parameters, and depend on local positions and validity gates rather than coarse event/block rank. The original coefficient construction, fifth path, all layout candidates and same-size contraction execute in every cell. Cross with whole_block_order supplied/canonical. Both ordinal diagonal cells are bridges to existing trials; duplicate cells are the new replacement contrast.
predictions: At common nonzero learned weights, local_duplicate predictions and gradients should be invariant within numerical tolerance to joint permutations of completely valid ten-event blocks, with partial/empty blocks fixed, in eval and equivalent train-mode instances including Dice buffers. Original block groups and within-block order remain predictive inputs.

The supplied_ordinal_bridge and canonical_ordinal_bridge should reproduce g1-r0055-identity_layout and g1-r0055-blocks_canonical respectively, up to any measured host numerical/execution differences; failure blocks scientific interpretation.

The ordinal click-AUC layout gap was0.0024606687549781. Predict that duplicate replacement collapses this gap; use all four cells and report the difference in layout effects, not only the best score. Do not treat one seed or full-exposure counts as significance.

If coarse ordinal information is useful under this recipe, supplied_ordinal_bridge will outperform supplied_local_duplicate in full-validation click AUC. All task losses/AUCs, auxiliary regressions and cost changes remain visible.

Expected parameter count remains32192421 total,31793216 embedding and399205 dense; verify rather than assume. Sorting and unused coefficient construction remain, so this experiment makes no speedup claim.
falsifiers: Duplicate full-block permutation sensitivity beyond numerical tolerance at common weights, or changed valid/per-task event multisets, target, padding or eligibility, falsifies the implementation and requires correction before training interpretation.
A reproducible supplied/canonical duplicate gap with passed parity and invariance checks weakens the proposed mediation; inspect hidden order paths and optimization rather than assert success.

Equal or better supplied local-duplicate AUC over adequate paired repetitions falsifies useful information in the tested coarse ordinal channels under this fixed setting; it does not show all supplied history order is useless.
Failure of the ordinal bridges or changed parameters/initialization/source ownership prevents attribution even if a candidate scores better.
alternative_explanations: One frozen seed and one-pass optimization give preliminary performance evidence only; repeats require host authorization.

The duplicate replacement removes two information directions, reducing effective feature rank although learned capacity and coefficient norms are matched. It cannot separate information utility from optimization conditioning by itself.
Original groups, within-block order, partial-block placement and padding retain order information. This is not arbitrary-event permutation invariance or timestamp evidence.
BF16 reduction order and training normalization can cause numerical drift; native common-weight prediction/gradient/buffer checks must precede causal interpretation.

The earlier content canonicalization changes coarse moment semantics and optimization; its regression alone does not establish a temporal mechanism. Full reversal largely preserves group structure and invertible low-degree moments, so its near-null result is compatible with useful ordinal summaries.

The fifth coefficient has ordinal intermediate arithmetic, but under the frozen available/norm/duplicate settings its output depends on invariant local norms and gates based on the fixed mask. This is an audited algebraic expectation; test it natively and do not infer from names.
